description: This bar chart, titled “Efficiency via Chain of Unconscious Thought,” presents two metrics—Accuracy (%) and Token Count—for four methods: CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT, displayed as a dual-axis bar chart where each method has two bars, one for each metric. The horizontal axis lists the four methods in the order CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT, each with a corresponding colored bar: red for CoT, orange for CoD, light blue for CCoT, and green for CoUT. The left vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 70 to 100 in increments of 5, and the right vertical axis, labeled “Token Count”, ranges from 0 to 800 in increments of 100. For each method, the bar on the left represents its accuracy percentage, and the bar on the right represents its token count. The accuracy bars are labeled with their exact percentage values: CoT is 91.19%, CoD is 80.89%, CCoT is 88.50%, and CoUT is 88.40%. The token count bars are labeled with their exact values: CoT is 676.85, CoD is 534.24, CCoT is 445.91, and CoUT is 354.46. The bars are not sorted by value; they are presented in the order of the methods listed on the horizontal axis. The chart does not indicate any visual emphasis or annotation beyond the numerical labels on top of each bar.
